title: FounderEscalation
description: Escalation record produced when a governed PR requires founder review (Faraday Review Phase 1). `reasons` distinguishes real, expected escalations (e.g. pr_too_large_for_deterministic_classification) from infrastructure faults (github_api_budget_exceeded) so that calibration data for Phase 2 is not poisoned by misclassified infrastructure noise (Correction 2).

reasons.description: Sorted lexicographically by the producer; a list, never a set.
